WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-123.80285 46.136951, -123.804232 46.136958, -123.804399 46.136945, -123.805487 46.13694, -123.805503 46.13694, -123.806616 46.136954, -123.80672 46.136967, -123.806836 46.136988, -123.806941 46.13701, -123.807045 46.137042, -123.807134 46.137073, -123.807208 46.137111, -123.807256 46.137152, -123.807292 46.137207, -123.807319 46.13728, -123.80734 46.137367, -123.807372 46.137441, -123.807394 46.137497, -123.807427 46.137534)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-106.000822 45.61557, -106.001316 45.615596, -106.001434 45.6156, -106.001728 45.615588, -106.00219 45.615456, -106.002691 45.61551, -106.003086 45.615571, -106.003524 45.615637, -106.004178 45.615746, -106.004586 45.615818, -106.005165 45.615938, -106.005783 45.616091, -106.006117 45.616146, -106.006407 45.616169, -106.006847 45.616151, -106.007222 45.616127, -106.007691 45.616207, -106.008217 45.616424, -106.008953 45.616746, -106.009186 45.616902)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'Greenwood Cemetery Road' ELSE 'Barrel Springs Road' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;
